title.zh: 卷五十三 列傳第二十三 愍懷太子
title.raw: 卷五十三 列傳第二十三 愍懷太子 Volume 53 Biographies 23: Crown Prince Minhuai

title.zh: 卷85 文苑：袁躍 裴敬憲 盧觀 封肅 邢臧 裴伯茂 邢昕
title.en: Volume 85: Men of Letters: Yuan Yue, Pei Jingxian, Lu Guan, Feng Su, Xing Cang, Pei Bomao, Xing Xin
title.raw: 卷85 文苑：袁躍 裴敬憲 盧觀 封肅 邢臧 裴伯茂 邢昕 Volume 85: Men of Letters: Yuan Yue, Pei Jingxian, Lu Guan, Feng Su, Xing Cang, Pei Bomao, Xing Xin

value.zh: 愍懷太子
value.en: Crown Prince Minhuai
value.literal: Crown Prince Minhuai

value.zh: 太子性剛，知賈謐恃後之貴，不能假借之。
value.en: Yu refused to flatter Jia Mi.
value.literal: The crown prince's temper was stiff; knowing Jia Mi relied on the empress's power, he would not indulge him.

value.zh: 謐至東宮，或舍之而於後庭遊戲。
value.en: He left Jia Mi cooling heels while he played inside.
value.literal: When Mi came to the Eastern Palace he sometimes left him waiting while he played in the inner courts.

value.zh: 詹事裴權諫曰：「賈謐甚有寵于中宮，而有不順之色，若一旦交構，大事去矣。
value.en: Household Superintendent Pei Quan remonstrated: "Jia Mi is deeply favored in the inner palace yet shows disrespectful looks—if they ever turn on you, the great enterprise is lost.
value.literal: Household Superintendent Pei Quan remonstrated: 'Jia Mi is deeply favored in the inner palace yet shows disrespectful looks—if they ever turn on you, the great enterprise is lost.

value.zh: 宜深自謙屈，以防其變，廣延賢士，用自輔翼。」
value.en: You should humble yourself deeply to guard against change and broadly recruit worthy men to aid your wings."
value.literal: You should humble yourself deeply to guard against change and broadly recruit worthy men to aid your wings.'

value.zh: 太子不能從。
value.en: Yu ignored him.
value.literal: The crown prince would not follow.

value.zh: 初，賈后母郭槐欲以韓壽女為太子妃，太子亦欲婚韓氏以自固。
value.en: Guo Huai once pushed a Han match—Yu wanted it too.
value.literal: Earlier Empress Jia's mother Guo Huai had wished to take Han Shou's daughter as crown princess; the crown prince also wished to marry the Hans to strengthen himself.

value.zh: 而壽妻賈午及後皆不聽，而為太子聘王衍小女惠風。
value.en: Jia Wu and the empress forced Wang Yan's younger daughter Huifeng instead.
value.literal: But Han Shou's wife Jia Wu and the empress both refused and instead betrothed the crown prince to Wang Yan's younger daughter Huifeng.

value.zh: 太子聞衍長女美，而賈后為謐聘之，心不能平，頗以為言。
value.en: Yu resented losing Wang's elder beauty to Jia Mi.
value.literal: The crown prince heard Wang's elder daughter was beautiful while the empress betrothed her to Jia Mi; his heart could not rest easy and he spoke of it often.

value.zh: 謐嘗與太子圍棋，爭道，成都王穎見而訶謐，謐意愈不平，因此譖太子于後曰：「太子廣買田業，多畜私財以結小人者，為賈氏故也。
value.en: Once while playing go with the crown prince Mi quarreled over a move; Ying, Prince of Chengdu, saw and rebuked Mi; Mi grew more resentful and slandered the crown prince to the empress: "The crown prince buys fields wholesale, hoards private wealth, and courts petty men—all because of the Jia clan.
value.literal: Once Mi played go with the crown prince and they quarreled over the move; Ying, Prince of Chengdu, saw and rebuked Mi; Mi grew more resentful and therefore slandered the crown prince to the empress: 'The crown prince buys fields wholesale, hoards private wealth, and courts petty men—all because of the Jia clan.

value.zh: 密聞其言云：'皇后萬歲後，吾當魚肉之。
value.en: Mi quoted Yu vowing to slaughter the Jias after Jia died.
value.literal: I have secretly heard him say: "After the empress dies, I shall butcher them."

value.zh: '非但如是也，若宮車晏駕，彼居大位，依楊氏故事，誅臣等而廢後於金墉，如反手耳。
value.en: Not only that—if the imperial carriage halts and he reaches the great seat, following Lady Yang's precedent he will execute us ministers and lock you away at Jinyong like turning his hand.
value.literal: Not only that—if the imperial carriage halts and he reaches the great seat, following Lady Yang's precedent he will execute us ministers and lock you away at Jinyong like turning his hand.

value.zh: 不如早為之所，更立慈順者以自防衛。」
value.en: Better strike early, remove him, and set up someone kindly and tractable to defend ourselves."
value.literal: Better strike early, remove him, and set up someone kindly and tractable to defend ourselves.'

value.zh: 後納其言，又宣揚太子之短，布諸遠近。
value.en: Jia adopted the plot and smeared Yu empire-wide.
value.literal: The empress accepted his words and further broadcast the crown prince's faults throughout near and far.

value.zh: 于時朝野咸知賈后有害太子意。
value.en: Everyone saw Jia meant to kill the heir.
value.literal: Then court and countryside knew the empress meant to harm the crown prince.

value.zh: 中護軍趙俊請太子廢後，太子不聽。
value.en: Zhao Jun urged preemptive deposition—Yu declined.
value.literal: Central Guard Zhao Jun asked the crown prince to depose the empress first; the crown prince refused.

value.zh: 初，太子之廢也，妃父王衍表請離婚。
value.en: Wang Yan filed for divorce the moment Yu fell.
value.literal: When the crown prince was first deposed, his father-in-law Wang Yan memorialized requesting divorce.

value.zh: 太子至許，遺妃書曰：「鄙雖頑愚，心念為善，欲盡忠孝之節，無有惡逆之心。
value.en: After reaching Xu he sent his consort a letter: "Though I am coarse and foolish, at heart I wished to do good and fulfill loyalty and filial piety—I harbored no rebellious evil.
value.literal: After the crown prince reached Xu he sent his consort a letter: 'Though I am coarse and foolish at heart I wished to do good and fulfill loyalty and filial piety—I harbored no rebellious evil.

value.zh: 雖非中宮所生，奉事有如親母。
value.en: He claimed dutiful service to Jia despite birth.
value.literal: Though not born of the inner palace I served her as my own mother.

value.zh: 自為太子以來，敕見禁檢，不得見母。
value.en: Palace rules barred him from Lady Xie.
value.literal: Since becoming crown prince edicts confined me—I could not see my mother.

value.zh: 自宜城君亡，不見存恤，恆在空室中坐。
value.en: Since the Lady of Yicheng died I received no comforting word—I constantly sat alone in empty rooms.
value.literal: Since the Lady of Yicheng died I received no comforting word—I constantly sat alone in empty rooms.

value.zh: 去年十二月，道文疾病困篤，父子之情，實相憐湣。
value.en: Last twelfth month Daowen became gravely ill; the affection between father and son made us deeply pity one another.
value.literal: Last twelfth month Daowen's illness grew desperate—father and son pitied each other truly.

value.zh: 于時表國家乞加徽號，不見聽許。
value.en: His plea for son's title failed.
value.literal: Then I petitioned the throne for honors—permission never came.

value.zh: 疾病既篤，為之求請恩福，無有噁心。
value.en: He denied malice in praying for the boy.
value.literal: When illness grew grave I sought blessings for him—I bore no evil intent.

value.zh: 自道文病，中宮三遣左右來視，云：'天教呼汝。
value.en: Since Daowen fell ill, the empress sent attendants three times to see me, saying, "His Majesty summons you."
value.literal: Since Daowen fell ill, the empress sent attendants three times to see me, saying, "His Majesty summons you."

value.zh: '到二十八日暮，有短函來，題言東宮發，疏云：'言天教欲見汝。
value.en: On the evening of the twenty-eighth a short letter arrived, marked as a dispatch from the Eastern Palace. It said, "His Majesty wishes to see you."
value.literal: On the evening of the twenty-eighth a short letter arrived, marked as a dispatch from the Eastern Palace. It said, "His Majesty wishes to see you."

value.zh: '即便作表求入。
value.en: He requested audience.
value.literal: At once I drafted a memorial begging entry.

value.zh: 二十九日早入見國家，須臾遣至中宮。
value.en: He saw Hui briefly then reached Jia's halls.
value.literal: On the twenty-ninth morning I entered and saw His Majesty; presently I was sent to the inner palace.

value.zh: 中宮左右陳舞見語：'中宮旦來吐不快。
value.en: Chen Wu claimed Jia was sick.
value.literal: Inner attendants Chen Wu told him: 'The empress vomited ill this morning.'

value.zh: '使住空屋中坐。
value.en: They parked him in an empty room.
value.literal: She told you to wait seated in an empty chamber.

value.zh: 須臾中宮遣陳舞見語：'聞汝表陛下為道文乞王，不得王是成國耳。
value.en: Presently the empress sent Chen Wu to tell me: 'I hear you petitioned His Majesty to make Daowen a prince and were refused. A princely title means a territorial domain, after all.'
value.literal: Presently the empress sent Chen Wu to tell me: 'I hear you petitioned His Majesty to make Daowen a prince and were refused. A princely title means a territorial domain, after all.'

value.zh: '中宮遙呼陳舞：'昨天教與太子酒棗。
value.en: The empress called to Chen Wu from a distance: "Yesterday His Majesty ordered wine and jujubes for the crown prince."
value.literal: The empress called to Chen Wu from a distance: "Yesterday His Majesty ordered wine and jujubes for the crown prince."

value.zh: '便持三升酒、大盤棗來見與，使飲酒啖棗盡。
value.en: Chen Wu forced three sheng wine and dates.
value.literal: She brought three sheng of ale and a great tray of jujubes and made him finish both.

value.zh: 鄙素不飲酒，即便遣舞啟說不堪三升之意。
value.en: Yu pleaded low tolerance.
value.literal: I never drink ale yet sent Chen Wu back explaining I could not manage three sheng.

value.zh: 中宮遙呼曰：'汝常陛下前持酒可喜，何以不飲？
value.en: The empress called from a distance: 'You are always so pleasing when you hold wine before His Majesty; why will you not drink?'
value.literal: The empress called from a distance: 'You are always so pleasing when you hold wine before His Majesty; why will you not drink?'

value.zh: 天與汝酒，當使道文差也。
value.en: His Majesty has given you wine; it should make Daowen recover.
value.literal: His Majesty has given you wine; it should make Daowen recover.

value.zh: '便答中宮：'陛下會同一日見賜，故不敢辭，通日不飲三升酒也。
value.en: Yu cited earlier imperial banquet.
value.literal: I answered the inner palace: His Majesty granted ale one day—therefore I dared not refuse—but all day I never drank three sheng.

value.zh: 且實未食，恐不堪。
value.en: Empty stomach worried him.
value.literal: Moreover I had not eaten—I feared I could not endure it.

value.zh: 又未見殿下，飲此或至顛倒。
value.en: Besides, I had not yet seen Your Highness, and drinking this might leave me confused and unsteady.
value.literal: Nor had I yet seen Your Highness—I feared drink might overturn me.

value.zh: '陳舞復傳語云：'不孝那！
value.en: Chen Wu called him unfilial.
value.literal: Chen Wu relayed another message: "You unfilial wretch!

value.zh: 天與汝酒飲，不肯飲，中有惡物邪？
value.en: His Majesty gives you wine to drink, yet you refuse. Is there something harmful in it?
value.literal: His Majesty gives you wine to drink, yet you refuse. Is there something harmful in it?

value.zh: '遂可飲二升，餘有一升，求持還東宮飲盡。
value.en: I then managed to drink two sheng. With one sheng left, I asked to take it back to the Eastern Palace and finish it there.
value.literal: I then managed to drink two sheng. With one sheng left, I asked to take it back to the Eastern Palace and finish it there.

value.zh: 逼迫不得已，更飲一升。
value.en: Cornered he drank more.
value.literal: Pressed helplessly he drank another sheng.

value.zh: 飲已，體中荒迷，不復自覺。
value.en: After drinking it, I became dazed and lost awareness.
value.literal: After drinking his body grew confused and he lost awareness.

value.zh: 須臾有一小婢持封箱來，云：'詔使寫此文書。
value.en: Presently a young maid brought a sealed case and said, "The emperor orders you to copy this document."
value.literal: Presently a young maid brought a sealed case, saying, 'The edict orders you to write out this document.'

value.zh: '鄙便驚起，視之，有一白紙，一青紙。
value.en: He found white and green paper inside.
value.literal: I started in alarm and looked: there was one sheet of white paper and one of green.

value.zh: 催促云：'陛下停待。
value.en: Runners said the emperor waited.
value.literal: They pressed: 'His Majesty is waiting.'

value.zh: '又小婢承福持筆研墨黃紙來，使寫。
value.en: Chengfu added brush and yellow paper for the copy.
value.literal: Another small maid, Chengfu, brought brush, inkstone, and yellow paper, making him write.

value.zh: 急疾不容復視，實不覺紙上語輕重。
value.en: Rush left no time to read the forgery's sense.
value.literal: Haste would not let me reread; I truly did not notice the import of the words on the page.

value.zh: 父母至親，實不相疑，事理如此，實為見誣，想眾人見明也。」
value.en: Parents are kin closest of all—I truly did not doubt them; though matters went so, I have been slandered, and I trust the multitude will see it clear.'
value.literal: Parents are kin closest of all—I truly did not doubt them; though matters went so, I have been slandered, and I trust the multitude will see it clear.'

value.zh: 袁躍 裴敬憲 盧觀 封肅 邢臧 裴伯茂 邢昕 溫子昇
value.en: Yuan Yue, Pei Jingxian, Lu Guan, Feng Su, Xing Cang, Pei Bomao, Xing Xin, and Wen Zisheng
value.literal: Yuan Yue, Pei Jingxian, Lu Guan, Feng Su, Xing Cang, Pei Bomao, Xing Xin, Wen Zisheng

value.zh: 正光末，廣陽王淵為東北道行臺，召為郎中，軍國文翰皆出其手。
value.en: At the end of Zhengguang, Prince Yuan of Guangyang served as Northeast Circuit Commander and summoned Zisheng as Gentleman; all military and state papers came from his hand.
value.literal: At the end of Zhengguang, Prince Yuan of Guangyang served as Northeast Circuit Commander; he summoned Zisheng as Gentleman; all military and state documents issued from his hand.

value.zh: 於是才名轉盛。
value.en: His fame for talent then grew still greater.
value.literal: Thereupon his fame for talent grew still greater.

value.zh: 黃門郎徐紇受四方表啟，答之敏速，於淵獨沉思曰：「彼有溫郎中，才藻可畏。」
value.en: Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Xu Hong received memorials from the four quarters and answered them swiftly; facing Yuan alone he mused and said, "They have Gentleman Wen on staff—his literary power inspires dread."
value.literal: Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Xu Hong received memorials from the four directions and answered swiftly; facing Yuan alone he pondered and said: "They have Gentleman Wen there—his literary talent is formidable."

value.zh: 高車破走，珍實盈滿，子昇取絹四十匹。
value.en: When the Gaoche were routed, booty filled the tents; Zisheng took forty bolts of silk.
value.literal: When the Gaoche were routed and fled, treasures filled the camp; Zisheng took forty bolts of silk.

value.zh: 及淵為葛榮所害，子昇亦見羈執。
value.en: When Yuan was slain by Ge Rong, Zisheng too was seized and detained.
value.literal: When Yuan was killed by Ge Rong, Zisheng was also seized and held.

value.zh: 榮下都督和洛興與子昇舊識，以數十騎潛送子昇，得達冀州。
value.en: Heluo Xing, a subordinate commander under Rong and an old acquaintance of Zisheng, secretly escorted him with several dozen horsemen until he reached Jizhou.
value.literal: Ge Rong's subordinate commander Heluo Xing was an old acquaintance of Zisheng; with several dozen horsemen he secretly sent Zisheng off, enabling him to reach Jizhou.

value.zh: 還京，李楷執其手曰：「卿今得免，足使夷甫慚德。」
value.en: On returning to the capital, Li Kai grasped his hand and said, "You have come through alive—enough to make Yifu blush for his character."
value.literal: Returning to the capital, Li Kai took his hand and said: "You have now escaped—enough to make Yifu ashamed of his virtue."

value.zh: 自是無復宦情，閉門讀書，厲精不已。
value.en: From then on he lost all desire for office, shut his door to read, and honed his mind without cease.
value.literal: From then on he had no further desire for office, shut his door and read books, and refined his mind without cease.

value.zh: 資治通鑑第083卷
value.en: Zizhi Tongjian, Volume 83
value.literal: Comprehensive Mirror to Aid in Government, Volume 83

value.zh: 初，廣城君郭槐，以賈后無子，常勸后使慈愛太子。
value.en: Earlier Guo Huai, Lady of Guangcheng, because Empress Jia had no son of her own, often urged her to treat the heir apparent kindly.
value.literal: Earlier the Lady of Guangcheng, Guo Huai, because Empress Jia had no son, often urged the empress to treat the Heir Apparent with kindness.

value.zh: 賈謐驕縱，數無禮於太子，廣城君恆切責之。
value.en: Jia Mi was arrogant and repeatedly insulted the heir apparent. The Lady of Guangcheng scolded him harshly again and again.
value.literal: Jia Mi was arrogant and unrestrained, repeatedly disrespectful toward the Heir Apparent; the Lady of Guangcheng constantly rebuked him sharply.

value.zh: 廣城君欲以韓壽女為太子妃，太子亦欲婚韓氏以自固；
value.en: The Lady of Guangcheng wanted Han Shou's daughter as the heir apparent's consort, and the heir apparent likewise hoped to marry into the Han clan to strengthen his position;
value.literal: The Lady of Guangcheng wished to make Han Shou's daughter the Heir Apparent's consort; the Heir Apparent also wished to marry into the Han clan to secure himself;

value.zh: 壽妻賈午及后皆不聽，而為太子聘王衍少女。
value.en: but Han Shou's wife Jia Wu and the empress refused and betrothed the heir apparent to Wang Yan's younger daughter instead.
value.literal: Han Shou's wife Jia Wu and the empress would not agree, and instead betrothed to the Heir Apparent the younger daughter of Wang Yan.

value.zh: 太子聞衍長女美，而后為賈謐聘之，心不能平，頗以為言。
value.en: The heir apparent heard that Yan's elder daughter was beautiful, yet the empress gave her to Jia Mi. He was bitter and complained openly.
value.literal: The Heir Apparent heard that Yan's elder daughter was beautiful, yet the empress betrothed her to Jia Mi; he could not compose his heart and spoke of it with some resentment.

value.zh: 及廣城君病，臨終，執后手，令盡心於太子，言甚切至。
value.en: When the Lady of Guangcheng fell mortally ill, she took the empress's hand at the end and urged her with utmost earnestness to devote herself to the heir apparent.
value.literal: When the Lady of Guangcheng fell ill, at the end she took the empress's hand and ordered her to devote her heart to the Heir Apparent, her words very earnest.

value.zh: 又曰：「趙粲、賈午，必亂汝家事；
value.en: She also said: "Zhao Can and Jia Wu will surely ruin your household.
value.literal: She also said: "Zhao Can and Jia Wu will surely ruin your household affairs;

value.zh: 我死後，勿復聽入。
value.en: After I die, do not let them near you again.
value.literal: after my death, do not again let them enter your counsel.

value.zh: 深記吾言。」
value.en: Remember this well."
value.literal: Remember my words deeply."

value.zh: 后不從，更與粲、午謀害太子。
value.en: The empress ignored her and instead joined Can and Wu in plotting against the heir apparent.
value.literal: The empress did not obey and instead joined with Can and Wu to plot harm to the Heir Apparent.

value.zh: 賈后使董猛矯以長廣公主辭白帝曰：「事宜速決，而群臣各不同，其不從詔者，宜以軍法從事。」
value.en: Empress Jia had Dong Meng report to the emperor in the name of the Princess of Changguang: "This must be decided at once. The ministers are divided. Those who disobey the edict should be dealt with by military law."
value.literal: Empress Jia had Dong Meng, falsely in the name of the Princess of Changguang, report to the emperor: "The affair ought to be decided quickly, yet the ministers all differ; those who do not follow the edict ought to be handled by military law."

value.zh: 議至日西，不決。
value.en: Debate continued until sunset without resolution.
value.literal: Deliberation continued until the sun was in the west, without decision.

value.zh: 后見華等意堅，懼事變，乃表免太子為庶人，詔許之。
value.en: Seeing Zhang Hua and the others hold firm and fearing the plot might fail, the empress memorialized to depose the heir apparent as a commoner. The edict was approved.
value.literal: The empress, seeing that Hua and the others were firm in intent and fearing the affair might change, submitted a memorial to depose the Heir Apparent as commoner; an edict approved it.

value.zh: 於是使尚書和郁等持節詣東宮，廢太子為庶人，太子改服出，再拜受詔，步出承華門，乘粗犢車，車武公澹以兵仗送太子及妃王氏、三子虨、臧、尚同幽於金墉城。
value.en: He Yu of the Masters of Writing and others were sent with credentials to the Eastern Palace. The heir apparent changed his garments, bowed twice, received the edict, walked out through the Chenghua Gate, and rode a rough ox-cart. Sima Dan, Marquis of Chewu, escorted him with armed guards, together with his consort Lady Wang and his three sons Xian, Zang, and Shang, to confinement at Jinyong.
value.literal: Thereupon He Yu of the Masters of Writing and others were sent with credentials to the Eastern Palace to depose the Heir Apparent as commoner. The Heir Apparent changed his garments and came out, bowed twice and received the edict, walked out through the Chenghua Gate, rode a rough ox-cart, and the Marquis of Chewu, Sima Dan, with arms escorted the Heir Apparent, his consort Lady Wang, and his three sons Xian, Zang, and Shang together to be confined at Jinyong.

value.zh: 王衍自表離婚，許之，妃慟哭而歸。
value.en: Wang Yan memorialized to divorce her, and permission was granted. The consort returned home in bitter tears.
value.literal: Wang Yan himself submitted a memorial requesting divorce; it was granted, and the consort returned home weeping bitterly.

value.zh: 殺太子母謝淑媛及虨母保林蔣俊。
value.en: The heir apparent's mother, Lady Xie the Gracious Lady, and Xian's mother, Forest Keeper Jiang Jun, were executed.
value.literal: The Heir Apparent's mother, the Gracious Lady Xie, and Xian's mother, the Forest Keeper Jiang Jun, were killed.

value.zh: 賈后使黃門自首欲與太子為逆。
value.en: Empress Jia had a Yellow Gate attendant confess a plot to rebel with the heir apparent.
value.literal: Empress Jia had a Yellow Gate attendant confess that he wished to rebel with the Heir Apparent.

value.zh: 詔以黃門首辭班示公卿，遣東武公澹以千兵防衛太子，幽於許昌宮，令持書御史劉振持節守之，詔宮臣不得辭送。
value.en: An edict showed the confession to the ministers, sent Sima Dan, Marquis of Dongwu, with a thousand troops to guard the heir apparent at Xuchang Palace, and ordered Liu Zhen, Attendant Secretary with credentials, to hold him under guard, forbidding palace officials to escort him on departure.
value.literal: An edict displayed the Yellow Gate confessor's testimony to the excellencies and ministers, dispatched the Marquis of Dongwu Sima Dan with a thousand troops to guard the Heir Apparent, confined him at the Xuchang palace, ordered the Attendant Secretary with credentials Liu Zhen to hold him under guard, and decreed that palace officials might not take leave to escort him.

value.zh: 洗馬江統、潘滔、舍人王敦、杜蕤、魯瑤等冒禁至伊水，拜辭涕泣。
value.en: Jiang Tong, Pan Tao, Wang Dun, Du Rui, Lu Yao, and others defied the ban, went to the Yi River, bowed farewell, and wept.
value.literal: The Groom Jiang Tong, Pan Tao, Attendant Wang Dun, Du Rui, Lu Yao, and others braved the prohibition to reach the Yi River, bowed in farewell, and wept.

value.zh: 司隸校尉滿奮收縛統籌送獄。
value.en: Colonel of the Censorate Man Fen arrested Tong and the others and sent them to prison.
value.literal: The Colonel of the Censorate Man Fen arrested and bound Tong and his companions and sent them to prison.

value.zh: 其系河南獄者，樂廣悉解遣之；
value.en: Those held in the Henan prison were all released by Yue Guang;
value.literal: Those held in the Henan prison were all released by Yue Guang;

value.zh: 系洛陽縣獄者，猶未釋。
value.en: those held in the Luoyang county prison were not yet released.
value.literal: those held in the Luoyang county prison were still not released.

value.zh: 都官從事孫琰說賈謐曰：「所以廢徙太子，以其為惡故耳。
value.en: Director of Justice Sun Yan told Jia Mi: "The heir apparent was deposed because he was wicked.
value.literal: Director of Justice Sun Yan said to Jia Mi: "The reason for deposing and relocating the Heir Apparent is that he was wicked.

value.zh: 今宮臣冒罪拜辭，而加以重辟；
value.en: Yet you would punish palace officials who came to bid him farewell;
value.literal: Now palace officials offend the law to bid farewell; yet you add heavy punishment;

value.zh: 流聞四方，乃更彰太子之德也，不如釋之。」
value.en: If word spreads abroad it will only highlight the heir apparent's virtue. Better release them."
value.literal: if this spreads to the four quarters it will only make the Heir Apparent's virtue more manifest—better to release them."

value.zh: 謐乃語洛陽令曹攄使釋之；
value.en: Mi then told Cao Shu, Magistrate of Luoyang, to release them;
value.literal: Mi thereupon told the Magistrate of Luoyang Cao Shu to release them;

value.zh: 廣亦不坐。
value.en: Guang was not punished either.
value.literal: Guang was also not punished.

value.zh: 敦，覽之孫；
value.en: Dun was the grandson of Wang Lan;
value.literal: Dun was the grandson of Wang Lan;

value.zh: 攄，肇之孫也。
value.en: Shu was the grandson of Cao Zhao.
value.literal: Shu was the grandson of Cao Zhao.

value.zh: 太子至許，遺王妃書，自陳誣枉，妃父衍不敢以聞。
value.en: At Xu the heir apparent wrote to his consort proclaiming his innocence; her father Wang Yan did not dare report it.
value.literal: When the Heir Apparent reached Xu he sent a letter to the consort stating his false accusation; the consort's father Yan did not dare report it.
